# ScreenPrintFilter.com

ScreenPrintFilter.com is a free online tool for converting images into halftone dot patterns for screen printing and graphic design.

## Capabilities

- **Image Processing**: Converts any image (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF) into halftone dot patterns
- **Client-Side Processing**: All processing happens in the browser using HTML5 Canvas - no server upload required
- **Customizable Parameters**:
  - Dot Size: 2-30px
  - Spacing: 1.0-2.0x
  - Contrast: 0-100%
  - Brightness: -50 to +50
  - Dot Shape: Circle, Square, Diamond, Line
  - Angle: 0-360°
  - Custom foreground/background colors
  - Custom output dimensions

## Use Cases

- Screen print preparation
- Graphic design and illustration
- Creating retro/newspaper effects
- Preparing images for physical printing
- Artistic halftone effects

## Technical Details

- Built with vanilla JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas, and CSS
- No external dependencies or frameworks
- Responsive design for desktop and mobile
- Dark theme with orange-red accent color (#FF4500)
- Privacy-focused: images never leave the user's device

## API/Integration

This is a standalone web tool with no API. All functionality is available through the web interface at https://screenprintfilter.online/
